name: San Benito
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Central Coast AVA along the San Benito River near Hollister, with a moderate climate cooled by Pacific breezes. It contains Paicines, Cienega Valley and Lime Kiln Valley.
